status: pre-registered before any exp9 model was trained

base.cache: Kaggle kernel output akshayalgox/amlc26-exp7-h1-dump (version 2): h1_matcher_oof.parquet, h1_queries.parquet, h1_truth.parquet
base.rebuilt: nothing upstream of the matcher: retrieval, TF-IDF, candidate pool, parsing, pruner and exp7 pair features all come from the cache

folds: exp7 folds (salt amlc26-exp7-fold-v1, 5 folds) and exp7 early-stopping subset, recomputed from s1_id and asserted equal to the cached fold column
row_order: exp7 matcher row order = sort by (q, prune_rank); B0 must reproduce the cached OOF p (max abs diff reported)

lightgbm.num_threads: os.cpu_count() (4 on Kaggle CPU, as in exp7)

B1.purpose: round cap only (exp7 hit 600 in every fold)

B3.features: B2 minus the new group with the largest total split gain in B2
B3.run_if: B2 macro F0.5 > B1 in >= 4 of 5 folds

round_cap_policy: 1000 is fixed; it is not re-tuned after seeing results
decision_rule: exp7 family and grids (thr, topn, gap, expF) x {unconstrained, greedy}, selected per variant on DEV cross-fitted OOF only

acceptance_vs_B0.note: a variant is not preferred for its H1 mean alone

ranking: largest mean macro F0.5 gain among accepted variants; if within 0.0005 of the next, prefer fewer features
holdouts: H2, H3 and H4 are not read. H4 is sealed in the store (EXP8_SEALED_LISTS).
